app_store.name: RoleBeacon: Community Notify
app_store.subtitle: Targeted Discord Announcements
app_store.promotional_text: Precision role-filtered broadcasts with live Discord preview and anti-ban safeguards. Protect your bot token while notifying active members.
app_store.description:
RoleBeacon provides precision announcement tools for Discord community leaders, creators, and merchants.

Skip the server-wide spam. Select specific verified roles—such as VIPs, tournament players, or clients—and deliver announcements safely.

Key Capabilities:
- Role-filtered segmentation: Message exact member groups
- Live Discord DM preview: Check embeds and markdown before dispatch
- Anti-ban safeguards: Dynamic throttling protects bot tokens
- Fatigue cooldown: Prevents over-messaging community members
- Full scheduling: Set future announcements with local time conversion

Free tier available. Manage your community with clarity and confidence.
app_store.whats_new: Initial release with role segmentation, live DM preview, and anti-ban safeguards.
